# nwc-lnd-bridge

> Self-hosted NIP-47 wallet service for LND with invoice-only default capabilities.

## Documentation

- [Install and operate](https://github.com/forgesworn/nwc-lnd-bridge/blob/main/README.md): Local setup, wallet permissions and service configuration.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/nwc-lnd-bridge): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
- [nwc-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/nwc-kit): Use the TypeScript NIP-47 client to call the wallet service.
